findings.summary: Implementer report claims 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff touches only historical-sync-consumer.server.ts (1 file, 12 insertions/3 deletions) — no test file was added or modified. The existing test file (__tests__/historical-sync-consumer.server.test.ts) has zero occurrences of source:'intervals' and no coverage of the new hasMoreStrava/hasMoreIntervals/MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES branching at all, only pre-existing strava full-page chaining tests. This is exactly the kind of pagination/continuation logic (risk of infinite loop or premature stop) that most needs a regression test, and none exists for either the intervals empty-page-stops behavior or the MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES cap.
